Big Plans Ahead: Once stable, we’ve got exciting updates in the pipeline—more to share soon!

notes.title: Asteroid destruction Major Overhaul, Engine Upgrade + Price Increases
notes.notes:
Greetings NDi Community!


Our tech team has been busy and made a major discovery and breakthrough on rendering large-scale asteroids and planets that will be equal or better than the mining destruction shown on Space Engineers and Star Citizen, something we are very excited about!!!


Attention beloved community, the NDi crew has been overwhelmed with the huge undertaking of the potentially massive epic space adventure. In order for us to believe Episode one, we had to reshape with an attack plan focusing on the core mechanics while offering a lighter version of EP1. Some content has been cut or reworked, in order to provide a solid, more well-defined experience. 

NDi is dedicated to completing ARM, even though we are only an indie developer struggling financially (actually losing money just to keep the project alive) We still believe in the project and will ship it once it's complete and ready, so that we will attract more fans and continue to build a legacy along with future episodes.

With future episodes in mind, we are adjusting our Roadmap so that we can adaptively add on our other features and storylines that will further improve the overall gameplay experience.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10093891/e67e0bc77ce04af8038185902c93852874ca76f9.jpg[/img]

It's not a big secret, but we are utilizing the Unity engine, and now with the latest updates provided will allow for overall increased frame rates and improved graphics fidelity. Expect larger and more realistic looking asteroids to prospect, mine and survive...


During our time, we have once again rethought about how our storyline and narrative will work within our roadmap to shipping Episode one of ARM: Planetary Prospectors.  (more details in the link below)


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10093891/43ce951bf964c0d40aa28b612df033057d20304a.jpg[/img]


A bit of a heads up, if you haven't purchased the game already, now is a Great deal, because the price will be going up substantially as advised by our CFO, so we can deliver a more polished and well-crafted experience.


Even though we are still in pre-Alpha, early access, we are planning a future Kickstarter and would like your support, even if it's sharing and spreading the word.  Early adaptors will still have everything and more, we won't forget about you. We still need your support and feedback.

Check out this thread about the storyline, we are still accepting suggestions and feedback. Contribute and help change the shape of the game before it's too late!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/344890/discussions/0/3145094199292235817/

Let's kick some Asteroid A$$!

Sincerely the NDi dev crew

notes.title: Launch delayed Re-scope and Focusing on Episode Zero
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10093891/98567c7580a336334cceea60a9fd0b72dd097377.jpg[/img]

Greetings Space Miners, due to Community feedback, our limited resources its been decided that the best thing for us now is to deliver Episode Zero the Prologue. Which will be the story about the Space Miners working their jobs just outside of Earth's Orbit. The player learns through a more advanced Tutorial how to operate the MRRM (Mining Rescue Repair Mech) which has been a major complaint from the Community.

Keeping it simple the player will learn to navigate and operate the Mech so they can be trained and properly mine asteroids for minerals. Then use the credits to upgrade the MRRM.

[Spolier Alert]

Near the end of Episode One, Space Command identifies a radio signal anomaly coming from an oddly shaped asteroid just outside the asteroid and debris belt. The asteroid mining crew is assigned to investigate on a xeno- archeological expedition. 

The asteroid is massive and is made of some strange synthetic metallic material, that our rock and ice lasers have a null effect on. Even a Level 3 Drill, fully upgraded has no effect on the metallic surface and even breaks with prolonged use. 

A last one of the space mining crew members finds a crack in the armor so to speak. Ricky Raye finds an opening that is blocked frozen with ice. The player is then instructed to use the Ice Laser to melt away the blockage, so the crew can journey inside the asteroid. 

The crew enters the dark and eerie cavern, as they navigate they begin to discover that it appears to be some markings on the walls from some unknown alien race. Some distance sounds of scratching and crunching are heard coming from the center of the asteroid, which seems to be hollowed out to be a sort of alien temple. 

A low pitch hum, followed by the scurrying of something looking like an arachnid scurries off into a crevice once the spotlights reveal around a dark corner...The Captain back at Mission Control then tells the crew to use their Rock Drills on the crevice to create an opening. Reluctantly the crew begins to chip away at the rock debris blocking the path...

Once the rock debris has been cleared, a bright light coming from the center of a shrine with a bright glowing object that looks like an alien amulet, shimmering with different types of lights and colors never seen before.

Ricky Raye "Are you getting this Capt? It looks like some type of ancient alien temple with some type of shiny amulet that is creating the disruption signal."

Capt. "Get in for a closer look! That thing might be priceless, and that means we can all retire early."

As the crew flies towards the glowing amulet, electrical malfunctions begin to increasing effect the MRRM and begins shutting down systems. 

Ricky Raye "Boss this doesn't look good, I'm picking up massive electronic interference and some of my systems are shutting down, abort mission??"

Capt. "Negative, get close enough and carefully grab that alien artifact with the CLAW" 

The player is then instructed to get close enough and grab the alien artifact with the CLAW attached to the ARM.

Just as the player grabs the alien amulet, a bright light erupts, followed by a portal opening up, pulling and sucking the crew into the portal...

End of Episode ZERO: Prologue


Episode ONE starts (essentially what we have now on Steam Early Access)

The player wakes up in another alien dimension, captured by the alien AI Xterminator Sentry, as they begin to realize and piece back what had just happened. 

The crew is captured and forced to be asteroid mining slaves, controlled by the advanced alien AI...now they must discover and work as a team to find a way out fo the mining barge prison. Find and recover the amulet, so they can find a way back to their home dimension, back to Earth, back to see their friends and families. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10093891/32c13a35ea6aa9ed5d5977f4401d1523c69649c9.jpg[/img]

We really want to hear from our community about these changes, since we are still in Early Access, we have the time to adjust and make the changes. 
Do you have anything to add, or you would rather see done differently?

Join NDi and be apart of our crew, and help shape ARM Planetary Prospectors!

We are still looking for Full or Part Time experienced game developers. If you think you have what it takes, then send us your Resume, and in return, we can offer stocks, and eventually, a paid or contracted salary. 

Let's turn ARM Planetary Prospectors into a continuing episodic series that will be remembered in gaming History. 

info@nefariousdimensions.com

Join the community discussion on Trello, share your suggestions here

https://trello.com/b/6dByRD5r/arm-planetary-prospectors-ep0-road-map-public-comments-disscusion


Live Long, and Mine Asteroids!

notes.title: ARM Alive! on Life Support after taking some hits! Repairs then Launch
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10093891/e67e0bc77ce04af8038185902c93852874ca76f9.jpg[/img]Greetings enlighten Community, even our haters that gave us a negative review, we will hopefully, in time will meet your expectations and then in return your review will become a Positive. As it may sound like a Conspiracy theory, although, why do we only have 23 reviews and how little sales we had since our Launch date over a year ago. Sale or coverage, barely anything, most games get more coverage and exposer in the first Month or so. It's almost like something more NEFARIOUS is going on here, such as suppression of information amongst other antics. I'm not blaming Valve or any company, as we don't have any evidence other than usually low traffic. Maybe in part due to our lack of indie marketing experience, still seems odd from this perspective. Almost like a shroud of media blackout, or perhaps something more sinister, manipulating and pulling the strings...?

Joking aside, It's Actually all part of a more complex charade, meta-connectivity to the Psychological Sci-Fi Thriller motive, rather than attempting cheap, cheesy Horror jump scares. I encourage the Community to startup conversations about types of Psychological storytelling seen in Eternal Darkness and Metal Gear Solid. We have some different ideas on where we take the characters and the different types of relationships they can have with each other, and how they can be socially engineered and manipulated, against or together to achieve goals. Nothing is final in the game, we can adapt and make changes.

NDi's team and work Philosophies are similar and inline with the likes of Valve's leaked Employee's Handbook and Blizzard's credo.


 Hence we are still in Early Access, and will continue to be in this stage until myself, NDi Crew and the NDi Community are ready to Launch, be proud of what we made together as a combined united collective to improve the Quality of ARM Planetary Prospectors EP1 making it a smashing hit, with a chance to win some Awards.

As our small Indie Developer Spacecraft, pivots and and readjusts calibrations, sets a final coarse and destination for our road map to Final Launch EP1.

Some of our devs are teaching or working FT at other developers, thus making our progress much slower only being able to work PT at this point in time. We are looking to spread the workload around more, so we can have ARM completed to spec, sooner. We are reaching out to fill roles within the company, that we are sharing with the founders, and the future founders.

NDi is looking for the following Developers to help finishing ARM Early Access, and work on the secret project(s)

Graphics Shader Programmer
AI Programmer
Physics Programmer
Gameplay Programmer
VR Programmer
2D/3D Artist
3D Animator
FX Unity Artists 

We are looking to fill Lead roles, including a CTO role which we can discuss shares and other options. 

We are trying to be a social, super flat democratic company and Community:)

Send us your Resumes or message info@NefariousDimensions.com

Currently NDi has some investors and moving forward with a government grant.

We are going to be more transparent with the community, opening up a message board on Trello, where the Road Map, Bugs, Suggestions and chat about this and that can help improve the final version of ARM, so that we can win some Awards and be apart of that team that won!

https://trello.com/b/6dByRD5r/arm-planetary-prospectors-ep1-road-map

Unfortunately NDi has suffered some impacts from false DMCA claims, and invalid Copyright infringement claims, that led to legal matters that unknowingly took way from our development time and resources. Financially due to low sales and lack of exposer, making our sales very low and unable to pay the developers at this time. Instead stock, and IOU's were arranged. Some devs had to take other positions at other companies, plus many other issues that nearly grounded ARM indefinitely. Once our sales increase we will then be able to pay our developers and produce future sequels and other projects in the works.


Some pieces are still missing, some content not complete, with bugs to fix, however, now a clearer, more precise creative vision is developing based on constant community feedback and developer iterations. 

Our company NDi's Goal is to succeed in making a memorable gaming Masterpiece that will withhold the test of time, and be mentioned as a Future Classic, in the Smithsonian next to other Video Game works of Art. If you want to be a part of this, and help save ARM....Join NDi and become a hero for the Community!


Thanks Community, and reach out to your developer friends to see if you or they can contribute to this WIP work of art.

CMDR

notes.title: UPDATE after ordeal systems Back ONLINE
notes.notes:
Hi Community, 

It may seem like our ship may have malfunctioned and was blown out of the air, but we have regain control and adjusting coarse set to finalize for Episode one. We had some issues where our developer server was hacked and we nearly lost everything. Luckily we were with a bit of work, we were able to bring back ARM in its new form that has it inside a Prison Mining Barge. We are going with a much darker tone, and giving a miners perspective, that's duty is search and scavenge for minerals while avoiding detection of pirates and other entities. Risk wandering further into the belt for greater rewards, and risk being captured....just a few of the many changes major and subtle that continue to change over time, and with the feedback and input from the community. If you don't like something, make a report and we will fix it. Make a suggestion, and we will do our best to make it happen. We want our community to help shape the game, you want play. Plus we will also be awarding community members for participation and skills contributed.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10093891/fe8efb7c42b143fb56cf3381d0ed87b507bc4915.jpg[/img]


Players with better video cards can generate larger and denser asteroids, while slower video cards are optimized to only generate a few smaller ones. Like mining in real life, having better tools makes the job easier. This is a feature we continue to develop to provide more and larger sized asteroids and eventually fully destructible planet size asteroids, with atmosphere and some type of civilization. Of coarse this all takes time, and feedback from the community, we much rather take our time and craft a masterpiece.

notes.title: UPDATE on UPDATE Prison Mining Barge leaving the docks
notes.notes:
Hey community, just a quick update that we are nearly ready to release the next update that has the new Prison Mining Barge along with some other improvements. The Prison Mining Barge will be undergoing some additional changes before final release and will need the communities feedback to make sure its the best possible experience. Sorry for the delay, just we had some technical and hardware issues that came up, long story about mobos burnt out and server issues.

We are also interested on what the community things about dropping the psychological horror aspect and focusing more on the core gameplay of being a survival space mining game where the player has to escape a prison barge and eventually have freedom and operate a mining fleets with your friends online, while avoiding raiders, rival mining companies and other unknown alien entities that are unlocked as the ancient xeno-archaeological digs reveals the multiverse deep dark secrets. 

I would also like to remind the community that the art is not final and will be changing throughout development. That also this game will stay in early access until its reached the desired level of quality so that we can then go after some awards at shows.

Some of you maybe already playing NMS, and although there are some similarity to what we are doing being a space game that uses procedural systems. However we want to point out that we have for more differences than similarities. I do recall working on the ARM prototype in early 2014, when I saw the announcement of NMS, I was also excited to see what they could come up with and what kind of things we at NDi can learn from their mistakes, to make ARM a more entertaining survival space mining simulator. 

Some say that NMS over promised and under delivered, with such things as no real multiplayer nor fully destructible planets. These are all things that we eventually plan to have, just it will take development time for us to get there.


We are still on the lookout for Senior game developers that have some similar titles behind them, were also interested in chatting with passionate juniors that are looking to make a difference and learn and work together.
 
Thanks again, and looking forward to your feedback.

If you have a negative review, please contact me with any requests on what we should change so that you can change your review into a positive one.

info@nefariousdimensions.com

NDi Crew

notes.title: UPDATE this week! Prison Mining Barge and more!
notes.notes:
Hey community, apologies for not being as active on the community forums or social media. We have been really busy and focused on the dev side of things, and behind an indie company that is still looking to be fully funded to complete this and future episodes to the highest level of quality. Even if it means it might take a bit longer in the long run to get the version for final release. This is every important for us to hear from the community and have feedback so we can address those issues. If our response time is slow, we will work with finding a Community Manager that will hand most of the forums.

We value and factor in all criticism and bad bugs found so we can improve the game further with each iteration. If you find bugs, please report them with the R button. Then we can track and reward points for your discoveries and suggestions. If you find bugs or something you would like fixed, please contact us first and let us know so we can fix that issue in for the next update.

Being that we are a startup indie, it would be great if we can change some of the negative reviews once the issues are fixed, if you still have problems with the game, please let us know and we will try to make it better. If your unhappy, please come talk to us first, and let us know what is wrong them we can work together and make the game kick ass.


The next update that will be out this week will include the new Prison Mining Barge, that will have players enslaved by a benevolent AI to work as asteroid miners. Then make friends with cell mates, and find a way to escape or take over the barge. The barge will also be a fortification for the player to run for protection, while being chased by pirates and other entities. Although this is not the final version we will be updating the exterior and the interiors as we complete this episode.

As for VIVE support, we had to rebuild our workstation for VR as we needed a new mobo. We will work extra hard to have at least the HMD VIVE supported in the next coming weeks as a hot fix.

Bug fixes and optimization to the asteroids, mores fixes coming in the next update along with improved Pirates and Merchant ship.


Sorry if some of the updates take a bit longer or if there is a delay in the community, as most developers are working part time, some with other full time jobs in the industry. 

The next update will be ready this week, it would be a great help to test it out for us and find those bugs and make those suggestions. We need our community to shape this game into an award winning game, that we will continue to work on for years to come.




NDi Crew

notes.title: Asteroid Destruction Improvements and Mining Barge +more in next update
notes.notes:
Greetings ARM community, at NDi we have been busy creating and building a better space flight simulator that has an optional psychological horror storyline. Procedural generation and player choices within the multiverse will further allow for near unlimited expanded universes. Eventually, we will expand our game and allow Multiplayer that can either connection with other players universes, then decided to join each other's world or even go back in time or to another dimension.

These are things that the team is working on and developing further so we can bring the best user experience possible, and open up many more possibilities. 

Teaser for the next update, we will have newly optimized asteroids procedural generation and destruction. Big wins for expanding the limitations and the performance issues. Asteroids will further be worked on to provide the most fun and realistic space mining flight simulator, mix with a psychological adventure.

We are happy to finally bring in the newly designed and constructed Mining Barge, as it will play a significant role in the game, as the player will eventually use wit and hard work to find a way to freedom. 

Other than that we have been fixing many of the bugs that keep coming in. Good work community team members for finding those bugs and making those suggestions. 

We are bringing on a couple new developers that will help adding quality and polish, maybe even an extra feature or two. We are always interested in talking with developers who are interested in joining the team. If you want to make fun and amazing games, and have the passion and skills we can build our dreams together.

The key objective is to get ARM to finely refined Award winning game, that will be played and remembered for years to come.


Looking forward to proving you the next update and gather more feedback that we can iterate on.

Thanks Community

NDi Dev Crew

Hello ARM community, this month our dev team has been busy refining features, making improvements and optimizations. As we have a few important trade shows in the new few months. There is even new amazing art that we are excited to share and get into the next update, including a Merchant ship to trade minerals for rare items. Along with Pirates that will chase after the player and demand the cargo, or face the consequences. 


Supports Oculus Rift CV1 
AI improvements, behaviors and turrets attack angles. 
Debris now have a fracture mesh that will split apart
Optimization and improvements for the meteor storm system
Fixes to the Upgrade system
Improved Inventory System
Improvements to particle system
VR and non-VR improvements to the UI and UX
Improved physics optimizations and realism
Improved visuals of space and stars
Hundreds of bug fixes and framerate optimizations 


Next week we will complete the setup of our Vive Pre SDK to make sure the HMD is supported, and then after we will begin to work on the IR room tracking. So the player can walk around inside the jail cell. 

This month we are preparing a special build that we will be showing at trade shows. We will continue to work on improving the graphics and design with a whole new redesigned Mining Barge and MRRM mining mech.

Polish and more animations are being added to make the feeling of motion more fluid.

Merchant ship AI now supports weapon systems, same as the Pirates. 

Final textures and models are coming in for the Merchant ship and Pirate ship.

We are also working with some new Writers to improve the overall story and make it more character driven. Our community is welcome to participate with steering the overall storylines and direction of the story and characters. 

In other news our CFO Alex Pryor will be leading the business team, as we are in discussions with investors and publisher. NDi is undergoing more organization as we will be releasing a more documented monthly Dev blog that will show our progress, and what we plan to do the following month. NDi is still hiring for a few key roles, as we look to fill some gaps in our team. We are always looking to talk with talented Artists, Programmers, Writers, Composers and other roles. 

Those interested can send a CV to info@nefariousdimensions.com

We still need the community help to find bugs, and make suggestions as we shape the game for final release. We intend to keep the game in Early Access, until its ready to ship. As our goal is to strive for quality, and win some awards and receive Great ratings. We want to build our community and retain our customers so they will trust our brand and label.

notes.title: Nefarious Dimensions is now an Official Oculus Developer
notes.notes:
Our CCO Clinton Bowman attended GDC last week, and had meetings with Publishers and investors. He also met with the Head of Developer Relations at Oculus and was able to obtain an Oculus Rift Engineering SDK for the CV1. 

Currently the team is working in upgrading from the DK2 to the improved CV1. Our main focus is improving the performance and fixing bugs.

Our dev team is busy working hard, so that we can have a fully functional build ready to present at PAX East. 

We still need the Communities help to find and report bugs, and also share on social media. Remember we will give points for rewards, when you help in these areas.

Our marketing plan, is being worked on with a 3rd party company as we should have more coverage and marketing traction soon. We will then leverage this for getting grants, and starting a Kickstarter this summer.

We need the feedback from the fans, to make this game amazing, we really would rather keep the game in early access, than rush a game out and get a bad review. Now is the time to critique and tell us what you want changed.


Thanks for your support

notes.title: Many Improvements to Inventory, AI & Gameplay UPDATE 0.5
notes.notes:
UPDATE ver 0.5

This past month the NDi dev team worked on the newly improved Inventory system, where the player can pickup objects with the IK hand and then equip, inspect with zoom and rotate functions. Crafting has been delayed till episode two, although Ferris will be able to craft most tools needed to escape the barge.  

We still want to hear from the community about story ideas and dialogue suggestions, as the whole point of Early Access is to get a feel for what our audience really wants. The script and story has been rewritten a few times, because we are obsessed with providing the most thrilling and thought provoking story to fit within the ARM Planetary Prospectors lore and universe. Keep those comments and suggestions coming and you can be eligible for an upcoming contest. 

A bunch on improvements can now be seen in within the AI systems, the Xterminator overlords will now visit the player in the jail to wake them up, and even search the jail cells for illegal contraband. Don't get caught trying to escape, or suffer the consequences. The friendly MRRM's are also more intelligent and responsive to commands given.

Our Art team, is busy giving the entire game a graphical overhaul. We are even going as far as redesigning the Mining Barge, to have better graphics, but also be more optimized for future Xbox One and PS4 versions. The design has even been changed to provide better gameplay and a more interesting reveal. The MRRM is also undergoing design changes as the art will be used to show a more progressive damage and upgrade system.

Many major and minor bug fixes, have been submitted, Special Thanks to our community for reporting bugs and suggestions so our development team can work on creating a better user experience. 

Our main focus during the month of March, will be in preparing for the PAX East demo that we will showcase. Will you be attending? Let us know and it would be great to meet you.

After meeting with our Advisory Board, it has been decided to focus on ARM:PP development, and postpone our Kickstarter campaign till after we build up more of a presence on social media. We are a game development company and not a marketing company. However we have just initiated our 6 month marketing plan with a 3rd party marketing company that will help us get more recognition. 

Although our intentions are to complete Episode one for this fall, if the game is not ready for final release, then we will keep it in Early Access, until  we know that it will get excellent reviews, and possibility an award or two. We are dedicated to release a fun and quality game, so our fans will be happy and continue to support us for future episodes and other games. 

Our other mobile tie-in and completely new prototype is currently put on hold so we can put 100% of our resources into ARM:PP 

Thanks community, and if you would like to volunteer to help us with testing, marketing and more with a possibility to join the dev team. Send us an email at info@nefariousdimensions.com

Thanks Community!

Clinton Bowman
Nefarious Dimensions Inc. (NDi)
CCO

- Initial restructure of laser tool logic to optimize performance and make audio/animation support easier (commented out until finished)

notes.title: Next major Feature, Multiplayer or Building..?
notes.notes:
Greetings community, the NDi dev crew have been very busy, fixing bugs, getting VR working again and adding more additional content. 

We want to hear from the Community, to see what the next big feature should be, and why you want it, and how you would like to see it done?

Thanks for your support,

Happy mining and space explorationːsteamhappyː

Clinton Bowman
Nefarious Dimensions Inc. (NDi)
Chief Miner / CCO

 [list]
